<thought>Based on the molecular ion at m/z 179.0946, the monoisotopic formula C₁₀H₁₃NO₂ fits exactly. This corresponds to a structure with an aromatic ring bearing an acetamide group and an ethoxy substituent, giving the SMILES CC(=O)Nc1ccc(OCC)cc1.</thought>
